exp_Build_Message.name: exp_Build_Message
exp_Build_Message.description: This transformation sets the mapping variables MAP_SUBJECT and MAP_MESSAGE using the counters and descriptions set in the previous expression transformation.

fields.name: v_SUBJECT
fields.expression:
v_ENVIRONMENT ||
'Comp Time File loaded successfully for Pay Period:  ' || 
TO_CHAR(PP_END_YEAR) || '-' || v_PP_NUM

fields.name: v_MESSAGE
fields.expression: 'Number of Detail Records from Comp Time file	= ' || TO_CHAR(COUNTER_1)

expression_logic.expression:
v_ENVIRONMENT ||
'Comp Time File loaded successfully for Pay Period:  ' || 
TO_CHAR(PP_END_YEAR) || '-' || v_PP_NUM
'Number of Detail Records from Comp Time file	= ' || TO_CHAR(COUNTER_1)
